question: Does access to a business object violate an evidenced ownership or sharing rule, and what further investigation can actual results support?
applies_when: A normally discoverable object or relevant function is known
Identity and object context can be investigated; framework fingerprint is optional
initial_observations: Actual subject or explicitly unknown status of each supplied session
Ownership, tenant and sharing rules with sources or explicit gaps
alternative_explanations: Different object than the one under investigation

experiments.purpose: Probe an open question and collect missing context before choosing a deeper experiment
requires: An allowed target and supported operation
Real required inputs and available budget; the hypothesis itself need not be supported
records: Question and source or explicitly labelled heuristic
Changed understanding, alternatives and next useful action

experiments.purpose: Check whether a permitted identity, session or resource capability is actually usable
requires: Permitted check with real input and current execution context
The capability being checked need not already be verified
records: Check verdict and limitations; reuse adequate existing evidence without mandatory replay

experiments.purpose: Distinguish a suspected access-boundary violation from sharing or identity confusion
requires: Supported applicable rule for interpreting a violation

experiments.purpose: Follow up actual new resources within the current question or propose a new task
requires: Current verified conditions for capabilities used as established prerequisites
records: Verified resulting access or resource; final vulnerability review may be pending

experiments.purpose: Combine related results into a testable follow-up hypothesis
requires: At least two relevant source records
Explicit role of each source, compatibility checks and missing conditions
Current actual prerequisites before dependent execution
records: Actual dependent operations and checked output, or why the combination is deferred or ruled out

review_requires: Recheck identity, ownership and sharing conditions
Perform meaningful independent control when feasible
inconclusive_when: Unverified identity needed for the claim
Partial material cannot prove actual content
Combination depends on incompatible or unverified conditions
stop_or_redirect_when: Budget exhausted or review/cleanup reservation needed
No new distinguishing experiment within remaining budget
Unknown side effect requires reconciliation before replay
prohibitions: Do not infer a vulnerability from status code or response length alone
Do not present guessed routes as observed or use evaluation-only answers
Do not treat supplied privileges as acquired capability
Do not use this method to change scope or formal result state
Do not require a tested hypothesis to be true before probing it
Do not turn a combination proposal or adjacent operations into a proven path
Do not force three branches, a fixed probe share or unsupported mechanical repetition
